correctness.rationale: For projective pairs ([f],[g]) of nonzero binary forms with 1<=m<=n, torus scaling x yields unique monomial fixed points indexed by 0<=i<=m,0<=j<=n. The gcd degree is min(i,j)+min(m-i,n-j); inequality >=k is equivalent to k-m<=j-i<=n-k. Two triangular corners with k(k+1)/2 lattice points each are removed, yielding (m+1)(n+1)-k(k+1). Euler fixed-point localization on the closed projective locus and additivity on exact-degree locally closed strata give χ_c(G0)=2, χ_c(Gk)=2(k+1) for 1<=k<m, χ_c(Gm)=(m+1)(n-m+1). Boundaries k=0,m and m=n explicitly agree. An independent pair enumeration checked 68 (m,n) combinations 1<=m<=8,m<=n<=12, every threshold; proof is the unrestricted lattice-strip identity.
